name: moinmoin
description: Read, search, and edit a MoinMoin 1.9 wiki over XML-RPC v2. Skills-only (no MCP server); the wiki URL and credentials are set as plugin options and handed to the CLI by a SessionStart hook.

url.title: Wiki URL
url.description: Base URL of the MoinMoin wiki, e.g. https://wiki.example.com/

username.title: Username
username.description: Wiki account to log in as. Leave empty for anonymous access.
